title: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE
subtitle: TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. FIFTH-STAIR PUSH-UPS, DEAD BUGS, SHORT PLANK HOLDS. OWN THE BALANCE. OPEN THE CHEST AND SPINE TO FINISH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH STEP, DEAD BUGS, SHORT SHARP PLANKS. THEN BALANCE, A CHEST OPENER AND CAT COW. THAT DESK HAS BEEN BENDING YOU INTO A BLOODY QUESTION MARK. WE ARE STRAIGHTENING YOU OUT.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT CHECK YOUR BLOODY EMAIL.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. CHEST PUSHED. CORE BRACED. SPINE LOOSE. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GO AND SIT AT THAT DESK LIKE A MAN WITH A BACKBONE, NOT A BLOODY WILTED LETTUCE.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, A LITTLE WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. BODY IN ONE LONG LINE, HEELS TO HEAD. LOWER THE CHEST TO THE EDGE OF THE STEP, ELBOWS AT ABOUT FORTY-FIVE DEGREES. PRESS AWAY. NO SAGGING HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS. FIFTH STEP. THREE SETS. EIGHT REPS. ONE LONG LINE, HEELS TO HEAD. CHEST TO THE EDGE OF THE STEP. PRESS AWAY. IF YOUR HIPS SAG LIKE AN OLD SOFA I WILL BLOODY WELL NOTICE.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY. SHAKE THE ARMS OUT. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. TELL ME IF EIGHT FELT EASY. THAT IS HOW YOU EARN THE FOURTH STEP.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, ARMS TO THE CEILING, KNEES OVER HIPS. PRESS THE LOW BACK INTO THE FLOOR. SLOWLY REACH ONE ARM BACK AND THE OPPOSITE LEG LONG. BREATHE OUT. RETURN AND SWITCH. BACK STAYS GLUED DOWN.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK GLUED TO THE FLOOR. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG, SLOW. BREATHE OUT AS YOU REACH. DO NOT THRASH ABOUT LIKE A BEETLE THAT HAS HAD ONE TOO MANY.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STAY ON THE DECK. BREATHE.

exercises.name: KNEE-DOWN SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE, ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER, KNEES BENT. LIFT THE HIPS SO SHOULDER, HIP AND KNEE MAKE A STRAIGHT LINE. HOLD FIVE SECONDS. LOWER. SWITCH SIDES. KNEE-DOWN IS LEGAL. CLEAN AND SHORT BEATS LONG AND UGLY.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. KNEES DOWN. THREE ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER. HIPS UP. STRAIGHT LINE. FIVE SECONDS OF PROPER WORK. NOT FIVE SECONDS OF LYING THERE LIKE A BEACHED BLOODY SEAL.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. WE ARE BUILDING TO TWENTY SECONDS. NOT TODAY. BUT WE ARE GETTING THERE.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD
exercises.cue: FOREARMS OR HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, FEET BACK, BODY IN ONE LONG LINE. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES, BRACE THE BELLY, BREATHE. TEN SECONDS. THE INCLINE MAKES IT KINDER. THIS IS THE ROAD TO A TWENTY-SECOND HOLD.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANKS. THREE ROUNDS. TEN SECONDS. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. ONE LONG LINE. SQUEEZE THE BACKSIDE. BRACE THE BELLY. KEEP BREATHING. HOLDING YOUR BREATH IS NOT A BLOODY CORE EXERCISE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SHAKE IT OUT. BACK IN SHORTLY.
exercises.speakDone: STAIR PLANKS DONE. CORE IS ON NOTICE.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND WITH OVERHEAD REACH
exercises.cue: STAND TALL BESIDE A CHAIR. LIFT ONE FOOT A FEW INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. SLOWLY REACH BOTH ARMS OVERHEAD AND BACK DOWN, OVER AND OVER. EYES ON ONE SPOT. FINGERTIPS TO THE CHAIR ONLY IF YOU NEED THEM. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS WITH AN OVERHEAD REACH. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. FOOT UP. STAND TALL. ARMS UP SLOW AND DOWN SLOW. EYES ON ONE SPOT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT SWAY LIKE A BLOODY SAPLING IN A NOR'EASTER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PALM AND FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. SLOWLY TURN YOUR FEET AND CHEST AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, AWAY FROM THE EAR. BREATHE INTO IT. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN THE CHEST AWAY SLOW. SHOULDER DOWN. THIS UNDOES THE DESK HUNCH. DO NOT CRANK IT LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A BLOODY LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPENERS DONE. SHOULDERS BACK WHERE THEY BELONG.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON HANDS AND KNEES, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. BREATHE IN, LET THE BELLY DROP AND LIFT THE CHEST. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK TO THE CEILING AND TUCK THE CHIN. SLOW. ONE BREATH EACH WAY. CHAIR-SEATED VERSION IS LEGAL IF THE KNEES COMPLAIN.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. SIX SLOW BREATHS. HANDS AND KNEES. BREATHE IN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK. SLOW AND SMOOTH. THIS IS YOUR SPINE STRETCH. DO NOT RUSH IT LIKE YOU ARE LATE FOR THE BLOODY BAR.
exercises.speakRest: FIFTEEN. LAST ROUND COMING. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: CAT COW DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
